svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two flat seals, each 16 x 11 mm with a 9 x 6 mm opening in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle that matches the sensor's inlet and outlet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inlet seal (left, sits on the screen): 0.7 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outlet seal (right, sits on the floor): 1.0 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat, slowly. Mark the inlet seal so they cannot be swapped.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: centre each over its slot on the inner floor, 18 mm apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre to centre; a spot of adhesive holds it while assembling.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The sensor rests on both seals, so they seal its ports to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slots and the fan draws only outside air.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the sensor sits level on both seals.
